caption: There’s something about a warm banana crepe that just feels extra special… and this one comes together with pantry staples in just minutes! 🍌✨ Soft, naturally sweet, and perfect for little hands. 🥞 Easy Toddler Banana Crepes Ingredients: • 1 ripe banana • 1 egg • 1/2 cup all-purpose flour • 1/2 cup whole milk • 1 tbsp melted unsalted butter Directions: 1. Blend everything together until smooth. 2. Lightly butter a pan and cook over low heat. 3. Pour in the batter and cook until lightly golden on both sides. 4. Spread with Greek yogurt, add banana slices, roll it up, and slice into toddler-friendly pieces. 💛 For adults or older kids, add a little Nutella for an extra treat!
